aiStatus.partialHint: A model is missing. Open Settings to install it.
aiStatus.offlineHint: Ollama is not running. Highlights still work with basic scoring.

upload.formats: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM, or M4V · up to 8 videos, combined into one highlight

config.targetHint: The finished video aims for this length. It may be shorter if there isn't enough strong content.
config.noLimit: No limit: let the AI decide
config.noLimitHint: Keeps every clearly strong moment and stops when quality drops off. The highlight is at least the shortest length and never longer than a quarter of the video.
config.noLimitSocial: Not available for a social media short, which has a 60-second limit.
config.rangeSwap: The shortest length is longer than the longest, so the two will be swapped.
config.lengthMissing: Enter a highlight length of at least 1 second.

styleHints.auto: Picks the best moments for this kind of video.
styleHints.informative: Prefers clear explanations and key facts.
styleHints.social: Strong opening hook, made for social media.
styleHints.educational: Keeps lessons and explanations easy to follow.
styleHints.custom: Describe in your own words what to look for.

config.customFocus: What should the highlight focus on?
config.customFocusPlaceholder: For example: focus on the product demo, skip the introduction.
config.prioritiesHint: Pick one or more. When you pick several, use the sliders to say how much each one matters.
config.connectionPriorityHint: Favors meaningful affectionate interactions, lets strong moments breathe, and keeps the original scene audio intact.
config.quickPresetHint: Choose a starting point, then adjust any setting below.
config.audioFocusHint: Changes moment rankings using loudness and transcript estimates; it does not classify sound events or alter the original mix.
config.audioFocusNaturalHint: Favors audible stretches with less dialogue.
config.audioFocusDialogueHint: Favors stretches with more detected speech.
config.shortestClipHint: Leave empty (Auto) for the default of 1.5 seconds.
config.longestClipAuto: Auto: each clip is as long as its moment needs, up to {cap}. Type a number to set a limit.
config.longestClipSet: Longer moments are cut down to their most important part. Leave empty for Auto.
config.preserveHint: More space keeps the start and end of sentences. Less space makes tighter, faster cuts.
config.allowRepeatHint: Off: the same idea or scene is used only once. On: repeats are allowed up to the limit below.
config.maxRepeatHint: The most time repeated moments may take in total.
config.socialShortHint: Vertical 9:16 video, 15–60 seconds, with a strong opening.
config.frameRate25: 25 fps: TV standard in Europe, India, Australia
config.frameRate30: 30 fps: standard for web and social media
config.frameRate60: 60 fps: very smooth motion for sports and games
config.frameRateHintSource: Keeps motion exactly as recorded. Nothing is converted.
config.frameRateHintSourceKnown: Your video is {fps} fps and stays that way. Nothing is converted.
config.frameRateHintSame: Your video is already {fps} fps, so nothing is converted.
config.frameRateHintEven: Evenly spaced frames of your {fps} fps video are kept to reach {target} fps. Motion stays even and the file gets smaller.
config.frameRateHintUneven: Changing {fps} fps to {target} fps skips a few frames unevenly, so movement can look slightly jerky. Smooth motion avoids this.
config.frameRateHintUp: Your video is {fps} fps. A higher frame rate repeats frames, so motion only looks smoother with smooth motion turned on.
config.frameRateHintUnknown: The video is changed to {target} fps. If your video uses a different rate, frames are repeated or skipped to match.
config.smoothMotion: Smooth motion when changing the frame rate
config.smoothMotionHint: Creates new in-between frames instead of repeating or skipping them. Looks smoother, but creating the video takes much longer, and very fast movement can look slightly blurred.
config.rangeHint: Time ranges in the original video, for example 00:32-00:38. Separate several with commas.
config.cropHint: Only the selected area is analyzed and used in the highlight. Your original files are not changed. The same crop is used for every video.

progress.title: Analyzing
progress.confirmCancel: Stop working on this highlight? You can start again later, and finished steps are kept.
progress.logsHint: Technical details, useful if something goes wrong.
progress.failedHint: Finished steps are kept, so trying again continues where it stopped.
progress.cancelledHint: Start again to continue. Finished steps are kept.

review.title: Review clips
review.sourceTimeline: Where the clips come from in {name}
review.overTarget: The kept clips are longer than your goal. Remove or shorten a clip, or create the video anyway.
review.scoreHint: How strong the AI thinks this moment is.
review.adjust: Not quite right? Pick new clips that are…
review.adjustHint: This replaces the current clips with a new selection.
review.emptyHint: Try a different style or a longer highlight length.

localAi.notice: The AI models are not ready yet. Highlights still work, but the AI makes them better.

sectionIntros.optimize: Let the app choose the fastest settings this computer can run well, without lowering quality more than its hardware requires.
sectionIntros.ai: Choose the models that understand your videos. Changes on this page apply right away.
sectionIntros.speech: Turns what is said in your videos into text. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
sectionIntros.video: How scenes are detected and how the finished highlight is saved.
sectionIntros.storage: Space used by this app on this computer. Actions here apply right away.
sectionIntros.system: Used to choose models that fit. Bigger models need more memory and are slower without a graphics card.
sectionIntros.performance: Fine-tune how much memory and processor power the AI uses. The defaults suit most computers.
sectionIntros.connection: Where the AI app (Ollama) runs and how long to wait for it.

optimize.switchHint: Chooses the AI models and speed settings that suit this computer, and updates them if your hardware changes. Video quality, format, and your other preferences are never changed.
optimize.recommendedHint: These differ from your current settings. Turning on automatic optimization applies them.
optimize.reviewHint: Your current values are remembered, so you can undo this.
optimize.upToDate: Your settings already match what this computer runs best.
optimize.offNote: Automatic optimization is off. Your settings stay exactly as they are until you change them.
optimize.managedNote: Automatic optimization is on. Changing a setting here turns it off, and your choice is kept.
optimize.undoHint: Restores the AI settings from before it was applied ({when}) and turns automatic optimization off.
optimize.confirmUndo: Restore your previous AI settings and turn automatic optimization off?
optimize.tipsHint: Based on how fast your last analysis ran. These are only suggestions; nothing changes unless you change it.
optimize.noHistory: After your first highlight, suggestions based on its actual speed appear here.

settings.aiIntro: The app uses three local models: one looks at the video, one reads what is said, and one turns speech into text. Nothing leaves this computer.
settings.hardwareHint: Used to choose models that fit. Bigger models need more memory and are slower without a graphics card.
settings.advancedHint: Most people never need to change these.
settings.measured: Measured while a model was running
settings.detected: Estimated from this computer. Run a test to confirm.
settings.testHint: Runs each model once and shows how fast it is.
settings.visionHint: Looks at pictures from each scene to judge what is happening.
settings.textHint: Reads the transcript and picks the most important things said.
settings.whisperHint: Writes down what is said. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
settings.speechSwitchHint: Writes down the speech and picks the most important things said. Turn off when the words don't matter, such as sports, gaming, or music videos: clips are then chosen from sound, movement, and scenes.
settings.visualHint: Uses AI to look at each scene. Turn off for much faster results on computers without a graphics card. Sound, movement, and speech are still used.
settings.visionScope: Which scenes the video model looks at
settings.visionScopeShortlist: Only scenes that could make the highlight (recommended)
settings.visionScopeShortlistHint: Speech is scored first, then the video model checks the promising scenes and every scene without speech. Much faster, especially without a graphics card.
settings.visionScopeAllHint: Slowest. Useful when important moments are purely visual and quiet.
settings.embedHint: A small model that compares meaning, to find repeated ideas said in different words and to match your focus. Optional: without it, word matching is used.
settings.ollamaUrlHint: Where the Ollama AI app runs. Keep http://127.0.0.1:11434 when it runs on this computer.
settings.timeoutHint: How long to wait for one answer before giving up on it.
settings.retriesHint: How many times to try again after an AI request fails.
settings.batchHint: Lower uses less memory. It is reduced automatically when it would not fit.
settings.visionCtxHint: Working memory for the video model. Higher allows more scenes per request but uses more RAM.
settings.textCtxHint: Working memory for the speech model. Higher allows more sentences per request but uses more RAM.
settings.threadsHint: How many processor threads the AI may use on this computer.
settings.whisperDeviceHint: Automatic uses an NVIDIA graphics card when available, otherwise the processor.
settings.sceneHint: Lower finds more scene changes, higher finds fewer. Default 27.
settings.codecHint: H.264 plays everywhere. The others make smaller files but some players can't open them.
settings.crfHint: Lower means better quality and a bigger file. 18 looks the same as the original; 23 is a good balance.
settings.storageHint: Space used by this app on this computer.
settings.clearTmpHint: Safe to clear at any time.
settings.clearCacheHint: Changing a highlight afterwards will analyze the video again.
settings.confirmClearCache: Clear saved analysis? Changing an existing highlight will then take longer because the video is analyzed again.
settings.deleteCompletedHint: Removes finished highlights and their videos.
settings.helpIntro: Ollama runs the AI models. Whisper turns speech into text. FFmpeg cuts and saves the video. Everything stays on this computer.
settings.helpCpu: Without a graphics card: install Ollama, keep the address as it is, and use the recommended small models. Highlights still finish; the AI steps just take longer. Turning off "Understand what is on screen" makes it much faster.
settings.helpGpu: With a graphics card: install the latest graphics driver, then Ollama. Click Test AI and check that it says GPU.
settings.helpAmd: AMD graphics: if the test still says CPU, restart Ollama with OLLAMA_VULKAN=1.
settings.helpTrouble: If a model is missing, click Install on its card. If the computer runs out of memory, choose the next smaller model. If FFmpeg is missing, install it and restart the app.

history.emptyHint: Your highlights will appear here once you create one.
history.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" and its files? This cannot be undone.
